rows.behavior: Vault has an identity-token role local-ov-sync with client id seaweedfs, ttl 900 and the literal claim local_ov_sync = JasperHG90/local, readable only through a policy on that one token path carried by a group whose sole member is the operator entity
rows.fails_when: the role is missing, its client id, ttl or template differ, the policy names any other path, or the group has a member other than vault_identity_entity.operator
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_local_ov_sync.py -q -k vault

rows.behavior: the rendered SeaweedFS IAM config has a role local-ov-sync trusting the vault provider only when oidc:local_ov_sync and oidc:sub (the operator entity id) both match by StringEquals, with a policy allowing only GetObject, PutObject and DeleteObject on arn:aws:s3:::ov-sync/JasperHG90/local/*, and no ci-* role names local_ov_sync
rows.fails_when: either condition is missing or not StringEquals, the policy allows another action or resource, or a ci-* role trusts local_ov_sync
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_seaweedfs_iam_config.py -q -k local_ov_sync

rows.behavior: the ov-sync consumer maps JasperHG90/local/ to viking://user/jasper/resources/local/, and no mapped folder is viking://user/jasper/resources/ itself or an ancestor of another mapped folder
rows.fails_when: the entry is missing or points elsewhere, or any mapped folder equals or contains resources/ or another mapped folder
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_local_ov_sync.py -q -k prefix

rows.behavior: localstack ov-sync-env mints the local-ov-sync token with the session's Vault token, posts it to SeaweedFS STS with DurationSeconds=900 and RoleArn arn:aws:iam::role/local-ov-sync, and prints exactly three export lines for AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN on stdout
rows.fails_when: the STS request lacks DurationSeconds=900 or names another role, or stdout holds anything but the three export lines

rows.behavior: localstack ov-sync-env prints nothing on stdout and exits non-zero when Vault refuses the token read or STS refuses the swap, with the reason on stderr
rows.fails_when: stdout is non-empty or the exit code is 0 on a Vault 403 or an STS error

rows.behavior: a how-to for syncing a local folder with ovsq exists and passes the how-to skeleton check, and the knowledge bundle is consistent
rows.fails_when: the page is missing, fails test_how_to_skeleton, or kmctl check fails
rows.command: test -f docs/how-to/sync-a-local-folder-to-openviking-with-ovsq.md && uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_how_to_skeleton.py -q && kmctl check

rows.behavior: after both roots are applied, eval "$(localstack ov-sync-env)" then an ovsq run with prefix JasperHG90/local and subdir projects/notes lands its files under viking://user/jasper/resources/local/projects/notes/, the credentials expire about 15 minutes after minting, and the same credentials get AccessDenied on a put under ov-sync/JasperHG90/localstack/
rows.fails_when: the files do not appear, the Expiration is not about 15 minutes out, or the put outside the prefix succeeds
just pre_commit or the cli test suite exits non-zero
rows.command: just pre_commit && uv run --directory cli pytest -q
